voice.text: Two kids pull the rope to the left. Three kids pull it to the right. [pause] Which team wins the rope? Tap your guess.

Now the force-tricks! The <emphasis>lever</emphasis>: push down on the long arm, and the rock lifts — though your hands alone never could.
The <emphasis>ramp</emphasis>: roll the barrel up the long slope instead of lifting it straight up. [pause] A longer path means a smaller push.
The <emphasis>pulley</emphasis> turns your pull around: pull down, and the flag rides up! [pause] And the <emphasis>wheel-and-axle</emphasis>: one easy turn of the big wheel does the axle's hard job.

The <emphasis>wedge</emphasis> turns a chop into a sideways split. The <emphasis>screw</emphasis> is a ramp wrapped around a pole. [pause] But remember: no machine gives free force.
